City library adds pickup lockers at two stations

The Maple City Library has installed secure book lockers beside the Central and Riverside transit stations. Members can now choose a locker as their pickup location when placing a hold online, making borrowed materials -------(9)------- outside regular branch hours.

-------(10)------- Once a reserved item is placed in a locker, the member receives a six-digit access code by text message.

The code remains active for three days. If the item is not collected -------(11)------- that period, it is returned to the branch for the next reader. Library officials say the pilot will continue for six months before they decide -------(12)------- to add lockers elsewhere.
